text: Washington stands open. So does the vendor pipeline. Nobody will notice the second one for a while.
style: ENTROPY's planner, a man in his sixties, on a handset he took without being invited. Deliberately unplaceable -- an educated, faintly mid-Atlantic English with every regional marker sanded off, which could be Western European or North American; keep it consistent throughout. Low pitch that never lifts; quiet, slow, deliberate pace with a lecturer's precision. Faintly amused. Nothing that happens tonight surprises him, including losing.
